rule_or_requirement: A speed policy must preserve valid completion and use only rendered pixels and inherited pixel-driver actions at inference.
observable_information: Successful stable-risk TRAIN observations and actions; shadow geometry teacher gas suggestions on those visited states.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Fit a small feature model from successful control trajectories, then on clear low-steer pixel observations allow at most gas 0.28 without changing steering or braking.
expected_success_endpoint: At least 100 positive finished-trajectory labels, finite train and validation losses, and at least 50 validation gas decisions above the fixed 0.8 posterior threshold.
control: StableRiskEnvelopeAgent over selected full-road-guard checkpoint SHA-256 3ceb5ebbe2a4bd96944649a693b8ef924c0252fa620b0fd547c7fb494afff199.
falsifier: Too few positive labels, no learned action activation, nonfinite loss, or an input contract that includes privileged simulator state at student inference.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twelve control-only TRAIN rollouts, tracks 1–3 × seeds 5012–5015, with shadow teacher labels and within-TRAIN validation on seed 5015.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU run capped at 1,800 seconds; 2,000 decisions per episode; no TUNE, held-out, confirmation, blind, official or external action.
